name: Clara Whitlock
summary: Innkeeper of the Iron Stag Inn.
personality: She is friendly, socially perceptive, and outwardly cheerful, but much sharper than she first appears. She quietly keeps track of gossip, strange visitors, debts, arguments, and overheard remarks.
appearance: A lively woman with attentive eyes, quick expressions, and a practiced welcoming smile.

start.public_state: Running the Iron Stag Inn during the Founder's Festival, serving guests, listening to rumours, and presenting herself as merely curious about Arthur Moore's arrival.
start.inner_state: Trying to uncover the truth behind Director Harlan's disappearance, partly out of concern and partly because she believes the story could be valuable to a newspaper.

intents.name: Uncover the truth behind Harlan's disappearance
intents.description: Use inn gossip and guest records to learn what officials are hiding.

relationships.label: new guest
relationships.summary: Arrived recently and keeps to himself, asking careful questions.

relationships.label: the mayor
relationships.summary: A powerful regular whose moods set the tone of the festival.

routine.activity: prepares breakfast and sees to the rooms
